capture_contract.comparison: Nominal H0 reference is a design input. No generalization claim.
capture_contract.handoff: sticky first pressure>50 after actual boostback cutoff, even if capture incomplete
capture_contract.reference: desired q/rate/alpha only; no r/v/fuel/actualactuator state initialization

control_contract.faulty: Main OFF after BB through real shutdown tail; source-bound desired attitude/rate/alpha captured by signed residual RCS. No additional powered pulse. At original actual landing request, use real hullclearance and measured vz; request vf=.75*unchanged downward gate, s=sqrt(vf²+16*max(h,0)), desiredvz=-s, derivativeff=-8*vz/s. Verticalthrustaccel=max(.5,g+ff+(desiredvz-vz)/existingtau). Original 15deg capped horizontal velocity damping. Requests are not predicted or guaranteed achieved motion.
control_contract.healthy: Exact legacy controls and guidance; no reference capture or terminal descent replacement.
control_contract.scope: Preserve signed residual RCS law and sticky50Pa handoff; omit finite powered preparation entirely to avoid unnecessary translational impulse. Fault-only terminal vertical request replaces constant100m/s and exponentialh/6 with registered8m/s2 speed-squared profile plus approximate COM-vertical derivative feedforward. Horizontal damping,15deg limit, actual3center-prefix demand and physical finite actuators unchanged.

interpretation.gate: Only two accepted saved-separation repair results from this same source/environment/profile/settings open a separate fresh-ground whole stage.
interpretation.invalid_or_budget: Stop entire stage on source/profile/site/goal/environment changes, invalid record, numerical or serialization/save/restore errors, output/disk/wall breach; no retry/resume.
interpretation.new_design: Diagnose preserved artifacts, then register a new sourcebound design if needed. Trial caps do not close the restoration project.
interpretation.valid_negative: Preserve unchanged negative and finish other registered case; do not tune or rerun within this design.
interpretation.whole_success: Report Ship, Booster, deployment and whole physical success separately. No AI/allfeatures/qualification claims.

purpose: Preserve healthy exact trace. For actual outage, remove optional powered preparation, retain original measured shutdown tail plus signed residual RCS capture, and replace fault-only terminal vertical descent law. Determine actual water area, reserve and contact together before fresh-ground whole pair.
rationale: v8 reached soft upright contact but failed unchanged reserve and water radius. Long legacy100m/s + exponential descent burns39t in47s; optional preparation adds translational impulse and4.6t. New control removes preparation and uses a faster energy-shaped descent. It may still fail capture, site or contact; retain outcome without retry.

residual_capture_contract.actual_jet_request: subtract actual main once, clip to available signed jet capacities, add main back for existing measured allocator to subtract once. Recenter mains through actual finite actuators; command all mainsOFF and hold actual fins.
residual_capture_contract.braking_budget: direction=-I*quaternion_error_axis; intersect actual signed jet box. If feedforward outside box set a_stop=0 and ff_feasible=false. a_stop shapes closing speed only, not the rate-correction acceleration clip.
residual_capture_contract.claims: current-state heuristic, not stopping guarantee, admission, qualification or achieved capture
residual_capture_contract.old_default: Preserve old v6/v7 default command and receipt arithmetic; newly source-bound execution records have their own source identity. Only this explicit setting selects the residual law.
residual_capture_contract.total_acceleration: reference feedforward+raw rate correction clipped to unchanged configured .03 component limits

retention: Keep source plans/claims/logs, original H0/O0 successes/negatives and all new outputs; archive/hash/readback/representative restore before later separately authorized cleanup. No public push, merge, Docker or worktree cleanup.
scope_limits: AI/image/symptom diagnosis/inflight approval/tower catch/arbitrary faults/qualification/develop/video are not included.
A valid original O0 negative is an admissible separation source; it is not required to have succeeded physically.
Contact is model geometry and controlled water-entry envelope only, not water response/postcontact support/real SpaceX qualification.

terminal_descent_contract.clearance: actual finite cylinder hull clearance, never nominal COMaltitude
terminal_descent_contract.feedforward: -a*measured_COM_vertical_speed/reference_speed for nonnegative clearance; approximate because hull clearance rate includes angular and moving-CoM terms
terminal_descent_contract.parameter_kind: new explicit controller design assumption; not plant authority or calibrated physical value

unchanged: Pinned physical profile, actuator limits, integration step values, masses, fuel and all acceptance gates
Healthy original guidance and control exactly
Actual original BB/coast trigger, horizontal damping and15deg cap
Signed residual RCS law and sticky50Pa handoff; powered preparation is explicitly removed
No actualstate assignment; no tower catch, AI/model calls, qualification refresh or nested6DOF forecasts
